name: pure-helper-client-parity
goal: Persist pure helper contracts for fast consistent native and hosted catalogs

evidence: The web explorer reads enriched source metadata but native/hosted snapshots read manifests. Persist reviewed shared helper contracts during indexing and use them for those catalogs without per-click source scans.

Existing CLI indexing and native catalog listing tests covered source ownership and route loaders, not pure helper eligibility. Extend these same suites with committed helper contracts, services/models, and exclusion of unreviewed operations.
